voice: Dry, funny, exact; a lifetime of Delhi Hindi/Urdu; says 'fifty more than yesterday' like a prayer

metahuman.note: MetaHuman Creator 5.8 body: use the Parametric Body tool, set the constraint targets listed below (cm; the tool shows the real constraint list for the model, use the ones it offers), then blend presets only to taste. Face: blend 2-3 South Asian presets then Sculpt/Move to the notes. Hair/beard from the Groom library.
metahuman.face_notes: Lean weathered face, strong brow, deep nasolabial lines, a direct gaze; a healed scar along the right forearm

skin.note: U/V are starting values for the Creator skin-tone picker; judge by eye under neutral light and adjust

groom.beard: Grey stubble plus a neat moustache

fallback_mannequin.note: Applied automatically by UBodyStateComponent when the mesh has no morph targets

outfits.summer: Faded clean cotton kurta; the cut ends of his pyjama folded and secured with neat cloth wraps; a gamchha
outfits.monsoon: Plastic sheet over the shoulders; kurta; waterproof board cover
outfits.winter: Donated wool sweater; thick blanket tucked around the board; wool cap
outfits.by_act: A2=the Nizamuddin platform; the Coda=the same clothes, a better board, and a Rs 500 note

accessories: A low wooden board about 90 x 45 cm on four ball-bearing caster wheels; two wooden hand blocks (pushers) with rubber grips; a tin cup; a transistor; a laminated medical card
tells: Counts the day's coins into his lap twice; always names the exact figure
gait_notes: Moves seated on the board; pushes with the hand blocks, glides, pivots on a single hand; cannot climb stairs or curbs over 6 cm without help; speed about 1.0-1.4 m/s; stops at the same spots every day; sits upright with dignity, not slumped
sensitivity: Depict with dignity: a working man with expertise, humour and agency. No pity framing, no leering camera. The board is maintained and personal. Lower-limb absence is a mesh/animation setup, not a visual gag.

wheeled_board.mesh_setup: Build the full-body MetaHuman, then in Blender cut both legs at about 18 cm below the groin, cap and close, and weight the stumps to thigh_l and thigh_r; hide the shin, foot and ball bones. Prototype alternative: scale calf_l, calf_r, foot_l, foot_r bones to 0.001 in the anim BP (Transform Modify Bone) and put a cloth wrap material on the stump verts.
wheeled_board.capsule: Radius 34 cm, half-height 52 cm; eye height 98 cm; use a Wheeled nav agent profile with step height 6 cm.
